incident_spec.summary: Slow query execution with RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE waits and parallelism issues.
symptoms: RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE waits observed during high user connection counts.
CXCONSUMER waits indicating parallel query execution.
Slow query execution under memory pressure.
incident_spec.mechanism: Excessive parallelism and memory grants leading to RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE waits.

facts.evidence: Post mentions RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE waits during sp_whoisactive.
Post mentions CXCONSUMER waits linked to parallel query execution.
Post mentions MAXDOP set to 0 causing queries to utilize all CPU cores.
Post mentions memory pressure affecting query runtimes.
